id: title:arnohillen:emit a producttreepath literal union from the manifests

review.posthog_relevance: Adds shared TypeScript type definitions for product tree paths, potentially supporting frontend autocomplete and type safety.
review.reason: Adds a union type ProductTreePath and a serialized string representation of tree paths. P1.F1.H2 adds a serialized string representation. P1.F3.H1 adds a union type ProductTreePath. This is a localized, bounded change adding shared type definitions.
review.uncertainty: The complete chunk is missing hunks P1.F3.H2 through P1.F3.H32, so the full implementation and complete usage of these types are not visible. The benefit is inferred from the type definitions alone, not demonstrated by complete implementation or tests.
